boundary: Synthetic local software test; no external participants or outcome claims.
observer_position: Synthetic reviewer examines the exact input and preview without changing either.

affected_parties.role: Excluded voice deliberately recorded in the fixture

first_person: No human first-person testimony was collected in this synthetic test.
second_person: No dialogue was conducted; declined participation is preserved rather than simulated.
third_person: Only the supplied event and local software records are available.
fourth_person: Interpretive inquiry into missing relationships, not an experience of presencing.
dissent: Absence of a collected dissent report does not establish agreement.
blind_spots: External source truth and participant experience are not established.
attention: Inspect source, preview, scope and missing voices.
intention: Test release-policy mechanics without overstating the source claims.
agency: Release a bounded report only under human review; no external execution is granted.
alternatives: The reported event may be incomplete, misleading or unrelated to the intended explanation.
test_plan: Compare original input and preview before and after reviewer completion and restart.
limitations: Fixture completeness tests records, not lived knowing or empirical efficacy.
